description: The referrals credited to this affiliate, with the milestone each one reached and where its review stands. Every referral is reviewed by a person, so a pending one is not an earned reward. Nothing identifies the customer: the connector cannot show who was referred, because that data is not on this surface.

limit.description: How many rows to return. Default 20.

locale.description: The language the affiliate is writing in — set it from their own messages. Everything meant to be read back to them comes back in this language.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page.

status.description: Only referrals in this review state.

name: my_referrals

kind.description: The milestone this referral reached: lead, quote or sale.

payout_status.description: Where the gift card stands, when one is owed.

reward_cents.description: The reward on this referral, in cents. Only an approved one is confirmed.

status.description: pending, approved or denied. Pending is still in review.

title: The affiliate's own referrals
